support.quote:
I have successfully completed the CO2 adsorption workflow on the Cuprous Oxide slab. The workflow included:

1. Retrieved the Cu2O bulk structure (mp-361) from Materials Project
2. Retrieved the CO2 molecule structure (mp-644607) from Materials Project
3. Generated slabs from the Cu2O bulk structure with miller index [1,1,1], min_slab_size=12, and min_vacuum_size=5
4. Selected slab at index 0
5. Identified adsorption sites on the slab
6. Selected the "ontop" site at index 0
7. Added the CO2 adsorbate at height 2.0 Angstroms above the selected site
8. Saved the final combined structure to "slab_with_co2.cif"
The CO2 adsorption workflow completed successfully: slab retrieved, CO2 placed at ontop site index 0 at height 2.0 Å, final structure saved as slab_with_co2.cif
